Well it came out that my brother confessed to Taylor that he was gay and had been “having feelings for another man.” They divorced after this and my brother started a new relationship with this man. I called him when I got the invitation and explained this to him and he started crying and saying that I wasn’t being fair and that he wants me to be there. I just explained that I couldn’t be there after everything that happened and I hung up. I think I’m being reasonable but my judgement is also clouded. Be honest.

However, it may also limit adaptability to new information or changing circumstances. **Conclusion**: The religious community plays a crucial role in shaping one's perspective, reinforcing values, and providing a supportive environment.
